blocks.title: Front panel
items: R.I.T. isn't found on VHF-DSC. Distress, Cancel and Squelch are.
Squelch: just below where noise breaks through.
Dual Watch: rapidly switches 1 receiver between 2 channels.
USA-INT: duplex (2 frequencies) to simplex (1) on designated channels in U.S. waters. Left on INT: you're heard, replies aren't, on certain channels.

blocks.title: Transmitter
items: Power: 1 W, 25 W; HIGH must be 8 to 25 W.
FM: deviation 5 kHz maximum, many sidebands.
Index below 1 to 1: unusually low transmit audio.
G3E is most common: phase modulation, analog, voice, 16 kHz wide.
Pre-emphasis: boosts higher audio 6 dB per octave; the receiver cuts the same.
SWR test: SWR meter or directional wattmeter ahead of the antenna coax, unused channel, PTT on.
Dummy load (artificial antenna): non-inductive 50 Ω resistor.
Spectrum analyzer: attenuator at maximum, LOW power, inductive probe.

items.name: SWR
items.example: 25 W forward, 1.5 W reflected: about 1.65:1, near normal 1.5:1

blocks.title: Receiver
items: Limiter: constant output amplitude from varying input.
Capture effect: rejects all but the strongest signal.
Ratio detector: ratio arm balance control bridge sets signal-to-noise.
10 dB quieting: about 1 µV is normal.
Full quieting: signal strong enough to completely quiet the background noise.
SINAD: (S + N + D) ÷ (N + D); reference 12 dB.
Minimum discernible signal: raise a signal generator from near 0 until AF output rises 3 dB.
